description: Source code for wrg.c, a C program handling WRG headers in MTD devices, including functions for fixing MD5 checksums and updating headers.

methods.name: wrg_fix_md5
methods.description: Fixes the MD5 checksum in a WRG header within an MTD device.

methods.name: mtd_fixwrg
methods.description: Fixes the WRG header in an MTD device at a specified offset.
